material_findings: GRASP full test 88.8% versus 63.5% without acceptance gate at K=4 and 40.1% without gate at K=1; equal probe compute without using the verdict reaches only 70.8%/67.2%, localizing substantial gain to validated promotion rather than skill writing or validation compute alone.

GRASP public code implements bounded ADD/MODIFY/REMOVE lifecycle, candidate forks/probes and best-validation rollback, but its ongoing per-skill effectiveness attribution is explicitly correlation-based rather than causal descendant credit.

MindMemOS generic public path immediately writes a newly minted version into the live local skill directory for the next batch; the server default draft status does not itself create a behavioral quarantine, and no independent candidate/incumbent A/B gate is present on that path.
SkillEvo uses separate generator/evaluator model families and requires human confirmation before production rollout; no official code or independent reproduction was located in this run.
SkillShapley exact-reference coalitions are scored on three benchmark instances each, with no verified task/model resampling or length-neutral control.
